# llm_chat

[← Command index](README.md)

Interactive chat with a local or cloud LLM, seeded with a prompt and files.

## Synopsis

```
llm_chat [options]
```

## Description

Opens a chat in the terminal against one of three backends: `ollama` (the native
Ollama chat route, at `[Tools.Ollama] ollama_api_base` in `~/JoyBox.ini` unless
`--endpoint` is given), `openai` (any OpenAI-compatible server such as llama.cpp's,
`http://localhost:8080` unless `--endpoint` is given), or `claude` (the Anthropic API,
using the key at `[UserData.Anthropic] anthropic_api_key`). Replies stream as they
arrive, except with `claude`, which returns each reply whole.

The conversation can be seeded before the first question: a system prompt from
`--system_file` and `--system`, whole files with `--attach`, and outlines with
`--outline`. An outline is a map of a file's structure without its body (functions,
labels, headings or keys, depending on the file type), which keeps a large corpus
within the context window. `--list_chunkers` shows which file types get a structural
outline; anything else is outlined by line.

With `--ask`, or with a question piped on standard input, it answers once and exits.
Otherwise it reads questions interactively. Commands in the chat: `/model [name]`
switches or lists models, `/attach <file>` and `/outline <file>` add a file,
`/read <file> [N-M]` adds a line range, `/region <file> <name>` adds one named region
and `/regions <file>` lists them, `/reset` clears everything but the seed,
`/save [file]` writes the transcript (`transcript.md` by default), `/tokens` shows
context use, `/help` lists the commands and `/quit` leaves.

## Options

### Backend

| Option | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `-b, --backend <backend>` | Service to talk to: ollama, openai, claude. Default: `ollama`. |
| `-m, --model <model>` | Model name; the first one the backend offers when omitted. |
| `-e, --endpoint <endpoint>` | Server base URL for the `ollama` and `openai` backends, e.g. `http://localhost:11434`. |
| `--api_key <api_key>` | Bearer token sent to the `openai` backend; taken from `LLM_CHAT_API_KEY` when omitted. |

### Context

| Option | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `--system_file <system_file>` | Text file whose contents become the system prompt. |
| `--system <system>` | System prompt text, appended after `--system_file` when both are given. |
| `-a, --attach <attach>` | File to place in the context whole; repeat for several files. |
| `-o, --outline <outline>` | File to place in the context as an outline of its structure only; repeat for several files. |

### Behavior

| Option | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `--ask <ask>` | Ask this one question, print the reply and exit. |
| `--max_tokens <max_tokens>` | Maximum number of tokens in a reply. Default: `2048`. |
| `--num_ctx <num_ctx>` | Context window in tokens: requested from Ollama, and used by every backend to check that the seed and replies fit; `0` takes the model's maximum from Ollama and skips the check elsewhere. |
| `-t, --temperature <temperature>` | Sampling temperature, a decimal such as `0.7`; ignored by the `claude` backend. Default: `0.2`. |
| `--list_chunkers` | Print which outline chunker handles which file extensions, then exit. |

### Common options

| Option | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `-v, --verbose` | Enable verbose mode. |
| `-p, --pretend_run` | Do a pretend run with no permanent changes. |
| `-x, --exit_on_failure` | Enable exit on failure mode. |
| `--no-preview` | Skip the preview confirmation prompt. |

## Examples

### Chat with the first model the local Ollama server offers

```bash
llm_chat
```

### Ask one question about a file and exit

```bash
llm_chat -m qwen2.5-coder:7b -a main.c --ask "What does parse_header do?"
```

### Seed a system prompt, one whole file and the outline of a large one

```bash
llm_chat --system_file review.md -a player.cpp -o game.asm
```

### Answer a question piped in on standard input

```bash
llm_chat -a notes.md < question.txt
```

### Use a llama.cpp server, checking the seed against its 32K window

```bash
llm_chat -b openai -e http://localhost:8080 --num_ctx 32768 -o engine.c
```

### Chat with Claude

```bash
llm_chat -b claude -m claude-sonnet-4-20250514
```

### Show which file types get a structural outline

```bash
llm_chat --list_chunkers
```

## Notes

- If the system prompt and attached files plus `--max_tokens` do not fit the context window, it refuses to start rather than let the server truncate silently. Use `--outline` for the large files or raise `--num_ctx`.
- Token counts are estimates (about 3.6 characters per token).
- With `ollama` or `openai`, the model must be one the server lists. With `claude` any model id is accepted and no window check is made.
- `--api_key` defaults to the `LLM_CHAT_API_KEY` environment variable.
- `-o` is `--outline` here, not an output path.
